We need to write a JUnit4 test file AttributeTest.java covering all methods. Must start with ###Test START## and end with ###Test END##. Provide imports, test class, test methods.

We need to test:

- constructors (null key throws exception? Validate.notNull). Validate.notNull will throw IllegalArgumentException? Actually Validate.notNull throws IllegalArgumentException. We need to import org.jsoup.helper.Validate? Not needed.

- getKey, setKey (including updating parent Attributes). Need to simulate Attributes class. It's part of jsoup; we can create a minimal stub? But we can use real Attributes class from jsoup library; assume it's available. Use new Attributes() and add attribute.

Attributes class is internal; we can instantiate and add attribute via attributes.put(key,val). But we need to test that setKey updates parent.

Simpler: create Attributes parent = new Attributes(); parent.put("foo","bar"); Then get attribute from parent via parent.get("foo")? Actually Attributes implements Map? It has methods. To get attribute object, maybe parent.get("foo") returns value. But we need attribute instance: Attributes has method get(String key) returns value; but we need to get attribute object maybe via parent.get("foo")? Not attribute. However we can retrieve attribute via parent.get("foo")? Not attribute.

But we can create Attribute with parent reference manually: new Attribute("foo","bar",parent). Then setKey to "baz". Expect parent.keys array updated; we can verify parent.hasKey? Attributes has method hasKey? Not sure. Might be simpler: after setKey, parent.get("baz") should return "bar". And parent.get("foo") should be null.

Similarly setValue should update parent values.

Test html generation: attribute.html() for normal attribute should produce key="escaped". Need to test escaping, boolean collapse.

Test boolean attribute collapse: For attribute with key "checked" and value "" or "checked" and output settings syntax HTML should collapse to just "checked". The html method will not add ="". So output should be "checked". Also test when syntax is XML, should not collapse: produce checked="checked" etc.

Test createFromEncoded: ensure unescaping.

Test isDataAttribute methods.

Test equals, hashCode consistency.

Test clone.

Test toString same as html.

Edge cases: setKey with whitespace trimmed.

Test constructor throws NPE for null key.

Note: Validate.notNull throws IllegalArgumentException? Actually Validate.notNull throws IllegalArgumentException with message "Argument must not be null". So we expect IllegalArgumentException.

Also Validate.notEmpty throws IllegalArgumentException if empty after trim.

All right.

We'll need Document, Document.OutputSettings, Entities. Those are part of jsoup library.

Write tests.

Implementation details:

- For html collapse test, need Document.OutputSettings out = new Document("").outputSettings(); set syntax: out.syntax(Document.OutputSettings.Syntax.html); default is html.

Call Attribute attr = new Attribute("checked", "checked"); attr.html() uses default Document with outputSettings (HTML). Should produce "checked". But html() method creates new Document internally with default output settings (html). So we can just call attr.html().

But we also need test with XML: Use html method that takes Appendable and OutputSettings. Use attr.html(new StringBuilder(), out) via protected method? It's protected; we cannot call directly. But we can use reflection or subclass? Simpler: Use Document.OutputSettings out = new Document("").outputSettings(); out.syntax(Document.OutputSettings.Syntax.xml); Then we can call the static html method: Attribute.html(attr.getKey(), attr.getValue(), sb, out); This will produce string.

Test shouldCollapseAttribute static method directly.

Test isBooleanAttribute static.

Test isDataAttribute: key "data-test" returns true.

Now write test file.

Add @Test annotation, and expected exception for constructor.

Will need to import org.junit.Test, org.junit.Before, org.junit.Assert.*.

Now produce final answer.
